gaps.sentence: Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.

gaps.sentence: She gave a moving ___ (PERFORM) of the sonata.
gaps.explanation: 'A performance of the sonata' — the act of performing.

gaps.sentence: The company needs to ___ (MODERN) its factories.
The soup is a ___ (MIX) of herbs and spices.
gaps.explanation: 'A mixture of' — the noun for a blend.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DIFFICULT) terrain slowed the rescue team.
gaps.explanation: 'Difficult terrain' — adjective needed; 'difficulty' is the noun.
'A brief introduction' — the noun from introduce.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (GRATE) for all their support.
